latestPreview.name: Voicewoven 0.1.30-preview.1
latestPreview.notes:
# Voicewoven 0.1.30-preview.1

This preview is for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. It is signed with an Apple Developer ID and notarized by Apple, so macOS opens it with the usual first-open question instead of blocking it.

Voicewoven records microphone and system audio, transcribes meetings locally, separates voices, and organizes meetings with Tags and Tasks.

## What is new

- **Back up your meetings to a folder.** Open **Settings > Storage** and choose **Back up meetings…**. Pick a folder, for example on an external disk or in iCloud Drive. Voicewoven copies your meetings, your Tasks, Tags, corrections, Ask history, taught voices and settings into a new folder named `Voicewoven backup` with the date. While the copy runs, the folder is named "(incomplete)" and gets its final name only when the copy finishes. Downloaded models and API keys are never copied. To restore, quit Voicewoven and copy the contents of the backup into the folder that contains it. The README has the steps.
- **A pronoun is never a task owner.** When the model names a person who is really a pronoun, such as "I", "you", "we" or their equivalents in the other languages, the task stays but has no owner, instead of showing that pronoun as the owner. Abbreviations written in capitals, such as "IT" or "US", are still kept as owners.

## Please read

- **Update from 0.1.29.** If you installed 0.1.29 from the DMG, this version can arrive through **Update and restart**. Check that your microphone and system audio permissions still work afterwards.
- **The backup has not been used on a Mac yet.** The folder window, copies to Documents, iCloud Drive and an external disk, quitting during a backup and restoring by hand are not checked yet. macOS may ask for permission to use the folder the first time.
- German, French, Japanese, Dutch, and Italian interface texts were translated by an AI model (Claude) and reviewed by another (Codex). The new backup texts in Portuguese and Spanish were written by the developer. No native speaker has reviewed them yet. Please report wording problems.
- Speech and AI models download separately and need additional disk space. Generated transcripts, speaker labels, summaries, and answers need review.

## Validation

The automated tests, the Rust tests and the production build pass on the exact source of this preview, and GitHub's hosted checks passed for each change since the previous preview. An independent review of each change found and fixed defects before it was merged. Not yet observed on a Mac: the backup checks listed above, and the in-place update from 0.1.29. macOS 14 has not been exercised.

releases.name: Voicewoven 0.1.29-preview.1
releases.notes:
# Voicewoven 0.1.29-preview.1

This preview is for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. It is signed with an Apple Developer ID and notarized by Apple, so macOS opens it with the usual first-open question instead of blocking it.

Voicewoven records microphone and system audio, transcribes meetings locally, separates voices, and organizes meetings with Tags and Tasks.

## What is new

- **Voicewoven can now update itself.** When a newer version exists, the line in the lower-right corner and **Settings > About** show **Update and restart** instead of **Download**. Voicewoven downloads the new version from the public releases page, checks two signatures (the release key and the Apple Developer ID), replaces itself and reopens. It never updates while you record; other work asks first. If anything does not check out, **Download** comes back and nothing changes. This only works when Voicewoven lives in **Applications**.
- **This is the first version that can receive such an update.** Install 0.1.29 by hand from the DMG, as before; the version after it can arrive through **Update and restart**.
- **A simpler permission window.** When a permission is missing, the window shows one headline, one sentence of why, the animated scene, at most three short steps with the macOS names in bold, and two buttons: **I did it** and one action. After an update it explains in one line that macOS forgets the system audio permission, and shows the drag tile beside the steps. When everything is allowed it shows a green check and "You're ready to record".
- **Voicewoven tells you when a newer version exists** (from 0.1.28, which was not published): **Voicewoven > Check for updates…**, **Settings > About > Check for updates…**, and **Check for updates once a day** (on by default, with a switch in **Settings > About**). A preview build also hears about a newer stable version; a stable build never hears about a preview.
- Everything from 0.1.27-preview.1 is included: the Apple Developer ID signature and notarization, the permission assistant when you record, and a click on a transcript line that jumps to it every time.

## Please read

- **Voicewoven contacts the internet on its own.** The daily check is one request for the public list of releases (`releases.json`, from `raw.githubusercontent.com`). An update downloads one file from `github.com/augustocbx/voicewoven-releases`. Neither sends an identifier, a cookie, a setting or meeting content, and both stay silent when you are offline. Turn the daily check off with **Check for updates once a day** in **Settings > About**; **Check for updates…** then still works when you choose it. The README describes the requests.
- **Update and restart** was exercised once on the developer's Mac with two unpublished test builds and a local server, not yet against the real releases page. The simplified permission window was only rendered in a headless browser, not yet used on a Mac. Please report anything odd.
- This build has the same Developer ID signature as 0.1.27-preview.1, so macOS keeps the permissions you gave that version. If you come from an older preview, macOS may ask once more for screen and system audio recording permission and for access to your saved API keys.
- German, French, Japanese, Dutch, and Italian interface texts were translated by an AI model (Claude) and reviewed by another (Codex). No native speaker has reviewed them yet. Please report wording problems.
- Speech and AI models download separately and need additional disk space. Generated transcripts, speaker labels, summaries, and answers need review.

## Validation

The automated tests, the Rust tests and the production build pass on the exact source of this preview, and GitHub's hosted checks passed for each change since the previous preview. An independent review of each change found and fixed defects before it was merged. Not yet observed on a Mac: the physical checks written in the specification of each change (`docs/request-queue.md`, `docs/guided-permissions-validation.md` and the update sections there list them), including VoiceOver, an in-place update from the real releases page, whether the microphone and system audio permissions survive it, the daily check without an internet connection, and the installed app on a second Mac. macOS 14 has not been exercised.

# Voicewoven 0.1.27-preview.1

This preview is for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. It is the first build signed with an Apple Developer ID and notarized by Apple, so macOS opens it with the usual first-open question instead of blocking it. Earlier previews were ad hoc signed.

Voicewoven records microphone and system audio, transcribes meetings locally, separates voices, and organizes meetings with Tags and Tasks.

## What is new

- **Signed and notarized.** The app and its disk image carry an Apple Developer ID signature and a notarization ticket. This also keeps the app's identity the same from now on, so an update no longer makes macOS forget a permission you already gave.
- **A permission assistant when you record.** If a permission is missing, the permissions window shows the steps as a short animated scene, with a **Pause animation** button (it does not move when your Mac is set to reduce motion). The window shows a tile with the Voicewoven icon that you can drag into the System Settings list. **Show steps** is on the red banners. When a recording starts with the microphone only, the window opens beside it, once each time you open the app, and it follows the end of the recording.
- **Clicking a transcript line jumps to it, every time.** A click on the text of a line plays from that moment, also when you selected some text earlier, in the same line or elsewhere. Selecting text with the pointer, or Shift-click, still does not move the audio. **Edit**, **Change voice** and the name and time buttons work as before.

## Please read

- This is the first build with the new signature, so macOS may ask once more for screen and system audio recording permission and for access to your saved API keys. After this build the identity stays the same across updates. If Voicewoven appears enabled in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen & System Audio Recording but system audio still does not record, remove it with the minus button, add it again with the plus button (or drag the app from Finder into the list), turn it on, and reopen Voicewoven.
- The animated permission scene, the drag tile and the window that opens beside a microphone-only recording were not yet seen on a Mac, and neither was the click on a transcript line after selecting text. Please report anything odd.
- German, French, Japanese, Dutch, and Italian interface texts were translated by an AI model (Claude) and reviewed by another (Codex). No native speaker has reviewed them yet. Please report wording problems.
- Speech and AI models download separately and need additional disk space. Generated transcripts, speaker labels, summaries, and answers need review.

## Validation

The automated tests, the Rust tests and the production build pass on the exact source of this preview, and GitHub's hosted checks passed for each change since the previous preview. An independent review of each change found and fixed defects before it was merged. Not yet observed on a Mac: the physical checks written in the specification of each change (`docs/request-queue.md` and `docs/guided-permissions-validation.md` list them), including VoiceOver and the installed app on a second Mac. macOS 14 has not been exercised.

releases.name: Voicewoven 0.1.26-preview.1
releases.notes:
# Voicewoven 0.1.26-preview.1

This preview is for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. It is ad hoc signed and **not notarized by Apple**. macOS may block it from opening. If you trust this download, follow Apple's guidance at https://support.apple.com/en-us/102445. Do not disable Gatekeeper.

Voicewoven records microphone and system audio, transcribes meetings locally, separates voices, and organizes meetings with Tags and Tasks.

## What is new

- **Recording is steadier.** Record and Stop always respond. You can record before the speech models are ready. A recording survives a microphone or headset change, falls back to the microphone when system audio is denied, keeps the Mac awake and warns before the disk fills. If the app, the engine or the capture stops unexpectedly, the meeting is finished by itself and you get a notification. Quitting asks first when work is running. A recording whose transcript comes out empty keeps its audio.
- **A first run that explains itself.** A welcome screen with a five-second sound test, a simpler **Now** screen (**Ready to record**), level meters that tell the truth, a quiet menu bar clock, and one **Meeting language** for future recordings. Audio choices moved to **Settings > Recording**.
- **Experiments are separate.** **Settings > Experimental** holds Ask, cloud AI, live transcription and **Learn from my corrections**. All are off on a new installation. Cloud AI and the API key routes are labeled, and **Remove saved API keys** deletes every saved key.
- **Honest progress and clearer lists.** Transcription progress shows real work, not a fake percentage. Meeting rows show a localized name and date. A meeting that cannot be read stays visible instead of disappearing.
- **Naming people.** **Settings > General > Your name** names your own voice in new transcripts. Default voice names ("Voice 2") appear in your language. Renaming a voice no longer marks the summary outdated.
- **Tasks that work by default.** Tasks opens on **All**, the sidebar counts every open task, a promise in your voice is proposed as **You**, and **Delete** and **Undo** exist.
- **Copy and export.** **Copy summary**, **Copy transcript**, **Export as Markdown…** and **Export as plain text…** in a meeting's Summary tab. **Copy recording notice** on the Now screen gives you a short, polite message to paste into the invite or the meeting chat.
- **Find in the transcript.** **Command-F** (**Edit > Find…**) finds a word in the open meeting and highlights every match.
- **Summaries that hold up.** A summary stays ready after an app update without a download. A decision or task the model got wrong is left out instead of failing the summary, and an unusable answer from the local model is asked for once more. The model sees who said each part. A summary that a recording interrupts starts again by itself. **Prepare summary model** runs in the background with one percentage, and after your first manual summary the app offers automatic summaries once.
- **Plain language and diagnostics.** Technical words are out of the main screens. **Settings > About > Copy diagnostic information** copies a short report for a problem report, with no meeting content.

## Please read

- This preview is ad hoc signed, so macOS can treat an update as a new app and stop honoring an earlier permission even though Voicewoven still appears enabled. The permissions window recognizes this case and shows the steps. If it does not appear, open System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen & System Audio Recording, select Voicewoven, remove it with the minus button, add it again with the plus button (or drag the app from Finder into the list), turn it on, and reopen Voicewoven.
- The first launch after this update checks the summary model once in the background, without downloading anything. For a few seconds it can show as needing repair, and Ask refuses until the check ends.
- Names of the people in a meeting are now sent to the summary model along with the text. With the default local model nothing leaves your Mac. If you turn on cloud AI, those names go to the provider you choose, as Ask already does.
- Summaries were not yet checked with the real model on real meetings after these changes, and the new model setup, the automatic-summary offer and the find bar were not yet used on a Mac. Please report anything odd.
- German, French, Japanese, Dutch, and Italian interface texts were translated by an AI model (Claude) and reviewed by another (Codex). No native speaker has reviewed them yet. Please report wording problems.
- Speech and AI models download separately and need additional disk space. Generated transcripts, speaker labels, summaries, and answers need review.

## Validation

The automated tests, the Rust tests and the production build pass on the exact source of this preview; an independent review of each change found and fixed defects before the build. GitHub's hosted checks did not run for the last changes (the account's Actions billing blocked them), so the local run is the evidence. Not yet observed on a Mac: the physical checks written in the specification of each change (`docs/request-queue.md` lists them), including the microphone, headset, sleep and quit behavior, VoiceOver, and the installed app on a second Mac. macOS 14 has not been exercised.

releases.name: Voicewoven 0.1.25-preview.1
releases.notes:
# Voicewoven 0.1.25-preview.1

This preview is for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. It is ad hoc signed and **not notarized by Apple**. macOS may block it from opening. If you trust this download, follow Apple's guidance at https://support.apple.com/en-us/102445. Do not disable Gatekeeper.

Voicewoven records microphone and system audio, transcribes meetings locally, separates voices, and organizes meetings with Tags, Tasks, and Ask.

## What is new

- **Two tools for when different people were merged into one voice.**
  - **Separate more voices.** In a meeting's Details, check **Separate more voices** before **Reprocess audio**. The voice detector becomes more willing to tell similar voices apart. It can also split one person into several voices, so it is off by default and applies only to that meeting. The transcript version that used it says so.
  - **Change voice.** Every turn in the transcript has a **Change voice** button next to Edit. It moves only that turn to another voice from the same audio source (microphone or system audio), or to a new voice. The text and timing stay the same. A voice that is left with no turns disappears, and to undo a move you move the turn back.

## Please read

- This preview is ad hoc signed, so macOS can treat an update as a new app and stop honoring an earlier permission even though Voicewoven still appears enabled. The permissions window recognizes this case and shows the steps. If it does not appear, open System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen & System Audio Recording, select Voicewoven, remove it with the minus button, add it again with the plus button (or drag the app from Finder into the list), turn it on, and reopen Voicewoven.
- **Separate more voices** was checked on one two-minute recording, where it separated two people that the default settings had merged. It has not been measured on other recordings, so check the result.
- The speech languages added in 0.1.23 were tested only with synthetic speech. Their accuracy has not been measured on real meetings. Summaries and Ask are still validated only for English, Spanish, and Portuguese.
- German, French, Japanese, Dutch, and Italian interface texts were translated by an AI model (Claude) and reviewed by another (Codex). No native speaker has reviewed them yet. Please report wording problems.
- Speech and AI models download separately and need additional disk space. Generated transcripts, speaker labels, summaries, and answers need review.

## Validation

Automated tests cover the new Reprocess option and how it is stored with each transcript version, moving a turn (including old voice ids, history and restore), the Details checkbox, the Change voice dialog and its keyboard and focus rules. A test on a copy of one real recording showed the two merged people separating with the new option while the default result did not change. Not yet observed on a Mac: both tools in the installed app (nine checks in `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-16-speaker-separation-controls.md`) and the checks listed for earlier previews. macOS 14 has not been exercised.

releases.name: Voicewoven 0.1.23-preview.1
releases.notes:
# Voicewoven 0.1.23-preview.1

This preview is for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. It is ad hoc signed and **not notarized by Apple**. macOS may block it from opening. If you trust this download, follow Apple's guidance at https://support.apple.com/en-us/102445. Do not disable Gatekeeper.

Voicewoven records microphone and system audio, transcribes meetings locally, separates voices, and organizes meetings with Tags, Tasks, and Ask.

## What is new

- **A window that guides you through recording permissions.** When Record finds a missing macOS permission, a floating "Recording permissions" window shows what to allow: the microphone, then system audio. It also lets you drag the Voicewoven icon into the System Settings list (or use the + button), recognizes a stale entry left behind by an update and shows the steps to replace it, and offers Quit & Reopen when macOS needs it. After the permissions are ready, one click on Record starts your pending recording; nothing ever records by itself. You can also open it from Settings.
- **More languages for speech recognition.** The speech language lists now offer the same eight languages as the interface, in the same order and each in its own name. German, French, Italian and Dutch work with the Nemotron Speech Multilingual model you may already have: there is no new download, and a model prepared by an earlier version stays ready. Japanese needs the optional **Nemotron Speech Multilingual Full** model (about 665 MB), installed only when you ask for it in Manage models. A language the selected model cannot force is shown disabled and names the model that can.
- **Fixes from 0.1.22.** The Edit button in the Tasks list is no longer squeezed into the checkbox column, the meeting tabs no longer overlap in German, the filters of the Ask tab no longer run together on one line, and the Brazilian Portuguese text uses the name macOS 27 gives to the Screen & System Audio Recording pane.

## Please read

- This preview is ad hoc signed, so macOS can treat an update as a new app and stop honoring an earlier permission even though Voicewoven still appears enabled. The new permissions window recognizes this case and shows the steps. If it does not appear, open System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen & System Audio Recording, select Voicewoven, remove it with the minus button, add it again with the plus button (or drag the app from Finder into the list), turn it on, and reopen Voicewoven.
- The new speech languages were tested only with synthetic speech (one sentence per language read by a macOS voice). Their accuracy has **not been measured on real meetings**.
- Summaries and Ask are still validated only for English, Spanish, and Portuguese. In our tests the small local model gave wrong numbers in Dutch, so check its answers in languages other than those three.
- German, French, Japanese, Dutch, and Italian interface texts were translated by an AI model (Claude) and reviewed by another (Codex). **No native speaker has reviewed them yet.** Please report wording problems.
- Speech and AI models download separately and need additional disk space. Generated transcripts, speaker labels, summaries, and answers need review.

## Validation

Automated tests cover the permission window flows, the engine, the helper protocols, the speech language lists and the model readiness rules. A real-model smoke test with synthetic speech ran all eight languages on the optional model and the seven Latin languages on the shipped one, and a model prepared by 0.1.22 still verified. Not yet observed on a Mac: the real permission flow (the first grant, a denial, a stale entry after an update, Quit & Reopen, and dragging the icon into System Settings), the language lists and a recording in the installed app (see `docs/guided-permissions-validation.md` and `docs/transcription-languages-validation.md`). macOS 14 has not been exercised, and fresh physical microphone and headphone acceptance on this build was not repeated.

releases.notes:
# Voicewoven 0.1.22-preview.1

This preview is for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. It is ad hoc signed and **not notarized by Apple**. macOS may block it from opening. If you trust this download, follow Apple's guidance at https://support.apple.com/en-us/102445. Do not disable Gatekeeper.

Voicewoven records microphone and system audio, transcribes meetings locally, separates voices, and organizes meetings with Tags, Tasks, and Ask.

## What is new

- **Eight interface languages.** Besides English, Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese, the interface now speaks German, French, Japanese, Dutch, and Italian. Choose one in Settings > General; the default follows the macOS language list. The menus, the menu bar item, and the texts of the macOS permission prompts are translated too.
- **Technical terms stay as they are.** MCP, API, and the names of products and models are not translated. Every other term uses the word people use most for that concept in each language, and the macOS names (System Settings, Trash, Microphone, and so on) use Apple's own wording.
- **Plurals, dates, and weeks follow the language.** For example, French counts 0 as singular, Japanese has one form, and weeks start on Monday where that is the local habit.
- Ask answers in the language of your question.

## Please read

- German, French, Japanese, Dutch, and Italian were translated by an AI model (Claude) and reviewed by another (Codex). **No native speaker has reviewed them yet.** Please report wording problems.
- Speech recognition and the local summary models are still validated only for English, Spanish, and Portuguese. Choosing another interface language changes the interface, not what the models can transcribe.
- Because this preview is ad hoc signed, macOS can treat an update as a new app and stop honoring an earlier permission even though Voicewoven still appears enabled. If recording fails with a permission message after the update, open System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen & System Audio Recording, select Voicewoven, remove it with the minus button, add it again with the plus button (or drag the app from Finder into the list), turn it on, and reopen Voicewoven.
- Speech and AI models download separately and need additional disk space. Generated transcripts, speaker labels, summaries, and answers need review.

## Validation

Automated tests cover the catalogs of all eight languages, the native menus, the packaged language files, and the main window in each language. Not yet observed on a Mac: each language in the installed app, the layout with long German and Dutch text and with Japanese, and the macOS permission prompts with the system language changed. Fresh physical microphone and headphone acceptance on this build was not repeated. macOS 14 has not been exercised.

releases.name: Voicewoven 0.1.21-preview.1
releases.notes:
# Voicewoven 0.1.21-preview.1

This preview is for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. It is ad hoc signed and **not notarized by Apple**. macOS may block it from opening. If you trust this download, follow Apple's guidance at https://support.apple.com/en-us/102445. Do not disable Gatekeeper.

- Claude Code connections work with current Claude Code clients (2.1.300 and later). A signed-in personal Pro or Max subscription is now recognized; earlier builds incorrectly reported it as signed out.
- Summaries, tasks and Ask answers generated through Claude Code now complete. Earlier builds blocked the client's own structured reply, so every request ended without a result.
- Claude Code model choices list the models your client actually offers, with clear names: Claude Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5, Haiku 5.5 and Fable 5.1.
- Sessions authenticated with an Anthropic API key are still refused on the Claude Code subscription route, so requests never switch silently to API billing.

Model weights download separately. Original audio stays on the Mac. Optional external AI connections send only explicitly selected transcript text through the chosen provider or client, and they require your own account authentication. The experimental acoustic adaptation from 0.1.20 is unchanged and remains off by default.

releases.name: Voicewoven 0.1.20-preview.1
releases.notes:
# Voicewoven 0.1.20-preview.1

This preview is for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. It is ad hoc signed and **not notarized by Apple**. macOS may block it from opening. If you trust this download, follow Apple's guidance at https://support.apple.com/en-us/102445. Do not disable Gatekeeper.

- Review a saved transcript correction with its original audio channel and spoken language, then explicitly save a local sound example.
- Optionally enable experimental acoustic adaptation in Recording settings. It needs two independent recording examples, matching source audio and agreement from a fresh local transcription of the excerpt. It starts disabled and never applies unconditional word substitutions.
- Inspect adapted turns, restore the original recognition, forget examples, or disable future use. Source-audio removal also removes derived examples.
- Preserve original word timings through edits and transcription history, with bounded processing, cancellation and temporary-audio cleanup.
- English, Spanish and Portuguese interface support includes the new controls.

The small independent Portuguese test accepted one correct word out of fourteen recordings, made no incorrect acceptance across ninety-eight other-label comparisons, and left thirteen recordings unchanged. Coverage is limited. This does not establish accuracy on full meetings or every voice, and it does not train the packaged model weights. Existing edits are not imported automatically; older transcripts need reprocessing for word timing.

Model weights download separately. Nemotron verification must be prepared for automatic acoustic use. Original audio and sound examples remain on the Mac. Optional external AI connections still send only explicitly selected transcript text through the chosen provider or client; available account authentication is required.

# Voicewoven 0.1.19-preview.1

This preview is for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. It is ad hoc signed and **not notarized by Apple**. macOS may block it from opening. If you trust this download, follow Apple's guidance at https://support.apple.com/en-us/102445. Do not disable Gatekeeper.

Voicewoven records microphone and system audio, transcribes meetings locally, identifies speaker segments, and organizes meetings with Tags. This preview includes transcript editing and revision history, language/model selection and reprocessing, live transcription controls, transcript-only retention, local model management, summaries, Tasks, Ask across tagged/date-filtered meetings, storage controls, and English, Spanish and Portuguese interfaces.

New integration and recovery work includes:

- Opt-in local MCP access for Claude and Codex, with read-only text access, scope controls and client revocation. Audio is never exposed by MCP.
- Optional Anthropic/OpenAI API access and authenticated Claude Code/Codex clients for summaries and Ask, with separate provider/model selection and credential setup. Choosing an external provider sends the relevant transcript text to it; recording and speech recognition remain local.
- A correction for multilingual audio whose model output contained useful speech without a language tag. Live-preview failures and skipped backlog are reported separately.
- Versioned installer checksums and automatic website release metadata.

Speech and AI models download separately and require additional disk space. Generated transcripts, speaker labels, summaries and answers need review. Transcript edits **do not train the speech model**. Mixed-language meetings and overlapping speakers can still need correction; echo cancellation and automatic call detection are not implemented. Remote backup remains disabled.

Automated and isolated packaged checks cover the delivered features. Fresh physical microphone/headphone acceptance on this build was waived by the owner. Paid API calls, unlocked-Keychain persistence and signed-in Claude inference require accounts/device access not available during acceptance. Developer ID signing and notarization are unavailable until an Apple Developer account is configured.
